title: Mesh to Part
summary: Make meshes from Part shapes at two accuracies, export and import an STL file, and make a mesh into a Part solid again.

credit.changes: Words in Simplified Technical English, FreeCAD 1.1 names. The page shows the conversions as Python; here the commands of the Mesh and Part workbenches do them, on a 10 mm cube and a 10 mm sphere. Export and import follow the Mesh workbench page. The checks read the new meshes, the file and the volume of the solid.

hints: Find the workbench selector in the toolbar.
Open the list of workbenches.
Workbench: Mesh.

steps.say: Select **Cube**. Push **{Mesh_FromPartShape|Create mesh from shape}**. Select **Standard**. Push **OK**.
steps.why: The mesher cuts each face of the shape into triangles.
hints: Select the cube in the tree first.
Use the Standard mesher with its default values.
Mesher: Standard, defaults.

steps.say: Select **Globe**. Push **{Mesh_FromPartShape|Create mesh from shape}**. Set the surface deviation to 0.5 mm and the angular deviation to 30 deg.
steps.why: Large deviations give few triangles and a rough sphere.
hints: Select the sphere in the tree first.
Change the two deviation values of the Standard mesher.
Surface deviation 0.5 mm, angular deviation 30 deg.

steps.say: Make a second mesh of **Globe**. Set the surface deviation to 0.01 mm and the angular deviation to 5 deg.
steps.why: Small deviations give many triangles and a smooth sphere.
hints: Use the same command again on the sphere.
Make both deviations much smaller.
Surface deviation 0.01 mm, angular deviation 5 deg.

steps.say: Select the mesh of the cube. Push **{Mesh_Export|Export mesh}**. Save it as **cube.stl**.
steps.why: STL keeps the triangles only: no faces, no features.
hints: Find Export mesh in the Meshes menu.
Set the file type to STL.
File name: cube.stl.
Find Import mesh in the Meshes menu.
Select the file that you exported.
File: cube.stl.

steps.say: Select the mesh that you imported. Select the **Part** workbench. Push **{Part_ShapeFromMesh|Create shape from mesh}**. Push **{Part_MakeSolid|Convert to solid}** on the result.
steps.why: A mesh becomes a solid only when its triangles close a volume.
hints: Both commands are in the Part menu, under Create a shape and Convert to solid.
Use the shape from the mesh as the input of the conversion.
Shape from mesh with a tolerance of 0.1 mm. Convert it to a solid of the cube's volume.

steps.say: Done: shapes made into meshes, a mesh exported and imported, and a mesh made into a solid again.
